mapper.select: SELECT FROM identity_permission WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM identity_permission WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM identity_permission p JOIN identity_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN identity_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id JOIN identity_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_enabled AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.is_enabled AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_permission (code, name, description, is_enabled, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE identity_permission SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, is_enabled = #{enabled}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM identity_role_permission WHERE permission_id = #{id}) + (SELECT count(*) FROM identity_menu WHERE permission_id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE identity_permission SET is_enabled = false, deleted_at = now(), version = version + 1, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
